# General Design System (GDS)

> GDS is a governed, cross-project React design system published as `@sovereignsquad/gds`. It is built on Mantine and ships 250+ components, design tokens, theme presets, and runtime systems (forms, tables, overlays, notifications, access gates, i18n). Every product surface is composed from shipped GDS contracts — never reinvented locally.

This file is the entry point for AI coding agents (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and any LLM tool). It tells you what GDS is, how to install it, the non-negotiable rules, and where to read more. When building UI for a project that uses GDS, follow these rules and compose the shipped components — do not author parallel primitives or raw CSS.

## Install

```bash
npm install @sovereignsquad/gds @mantine/core @mantine/hooks @mantine/modals @mantine/notifications @tabler/icons-react react react-dom
```

Wrap the app once in the single required provider, then compose components:

```tsx
import { GdsProvider, AppShell, MetricCard, SemanticButton } from '@sovereignsquad/gds';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <GdsProvider defaultColorScheme="light">
      <MetricCard label="Active adopters" value="18 apps" trend={{ tone: 'positive', label: '+2%' }} />
      <SemanticButton action="save" />
    </GdsProvider>
  );
}
```

`GdsProvider` injects the theme, tokens, fonts, color-scheme handling, and locale. Without it, components render unstyled or throw. Never add a second provider or a second Mantine `MantineProvider`.

## Non-negotiable rules for agents

- Compose shipped GDS components first. Mantine and Tabler are implementation dependencies behind GDS-owned APIs — do not use raw Mantine primitives or ad-hoc HTML/CSS controls where a GDS contract exists.
- Style with component props and theme tokens, not custom CSS classes or raw hex/px. Use GDS layout primitives (`GdsStack`, `GdsInline`, `GdsBox`, `GdsGrid`) and semantic props (`c`, `bg`, `mt`, `p`, `size`, `variant`, `color`, `radius`).
- `SemanticButton` (and `ActionBar`, `SemanticNavLink`, page/template actions) take a semantic `action` enum (`save`, `add`, `edit`, `delete`, `search`, `settings`, `export`, `refresh`, `submit`, …), not free text. Use `add` (not "create") and `refresh` (not "retry").
- Mantine `Select`/`MultiSelect` (incl. `AdminSelect`) take a `data={[{value,label}]}` prop, not `<option>` children.
- Every interactive surface designs loading / empty / error / disabled / success states — use `StateBlock`, `EmptyState`, and the `loading`/`error` props components expose.
- Access-gated content uses `GdsAccessGate` with `protectedContentPolicy="never-render-while-locked"` so private/paid content is never mounted while locked.
- Accessibility (visible focus, AA contrast, semantic labels, focus traps) and responsive/localized layout are acceptance criteria, not cleanup.

## Packages

- `@sovereignsquad/gds` — umbrella install (theme + core + admin); root, `/client`, `/server` entrypoints.
- `@sovereignsquad/gds-theme` — tokens, theme presets, VibeThemes, font lanes, motion system.
- `@sovereignsquad/gds-core` — layouts, cards, shells, forms, tables, overlays, charts, access, i18n.
- `@sovereignsquad/gds-admin` — operator scaffolds (`AppShell`, `PageHeader`, `ContentOpsEditor`, `ResponsiveDataView`).
- `@sovereignsquad/gds-a11y` — Playwright/axe accessibility test helpers.
- `@sovereignsquad/gds-eslint-config`, `@sovereignsquad/gds-compliance` — shared lint + adoption enforcement.

## Component families

- Layout: `GdsBox`, `GdsStack`, `GdsInline`, `GdsCluster`, `GdsGrid`, `GdsSplit`, `GdsSidebar`, `GdsContainer`, `GdsBleed`
- Shells: `AppShell`, `PublicShell`, `AuthShell`, `ArticleShell`, `DiscoveryShell`, `WorkspaceHeader`, `PageHeader`
- Cards/surfaces: `MetricCard`, `ProgressCard`, `ProductCard`, `EditorialCard`, `EditorialHero`, `InfoCard`, `SectionPanel`, `AccentPanel`, `StatsStrip`
- Forms: `GdsForm`, `GdsSchemaForm`, `FormField`, `FormSection`, `Select`, `TextInput`, `Switch`, `Radio`
- Data: `GdsDataTable`/`DataTable` (via `createGdsTableAdapter`), `SimpleDataTable`, `Table`, `GdsBarChart`, `GdsLineChart`
- Feedback/overlay: `EmptyState`, `StateBlock`, `GdsNotificationProvider`+`GdsNotificationCenter`, `GdsModal`, `GdsDrawer`, `ConfirmDialog`, `CommandPalette`
- Access: `GdsAccessGate`, `AccessSummary`, `AccessRecoveryPanel`, social/provider auth buttons
